It has no author focus style (outline none, no border change), but when it is focused the browser draws a blinking text caret (color #4d423e on white) inside the field. My live screenshots with the caret captured show 15 px changing at the start of the field, and the 'Termos mais buscados' panel also opens under the field on focus. Understanding 2.4.7 gives this as its own example of a visible focus indication for text fields ('a vertical bar is displayed in the field'), and the ACT rule passes on any changed pixel. Rampa's captures missed the caret, probably because the screenshot hides it or it was in its off phase. A team could still require a stronger ring as good practice, but this is not a 2.4.7 failure.
